chunks: All that is on the earth is passing,
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the impermanence of all things on earth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (55:26) is often interpreted not merely as a statement of physical decay but as a profound theological anchor reminding believers that all temporal authority and existence are contingent upon the Divine Will. It underscores the concept of *Fana* (annihilation) in contrast to *Baqa* (eternity), encouraging spiritual detachment from worldly pursuits while affirming the permanence of Allah's essence.
